prompt:
Create a looping sweeping animation for a humanoid character using a broom. Start in an athletic stance: hips lowered, spine and chest leaned slightly forward, feet staggered, knees bent. Both hands hold the broom: upper hand near chest, lower hand near waist. Keep the broom head on the ground in front of the feet.
Perform a fast left-right scrubbing motion to sweep an item away from the character. Rotate shoulders, upper arms, and spine with each stroke; allow slight elbow flex in lower arms and hands while keeping control of the broom. Hips and legs stay stable with subtle weight shifts; feet and toes remain planted. Maintain correct broom contact and angle. Use an energetic rhythm of 4–6 strokes per second. Make the loop seamless with no pop at the start or end.
